preconditions.description: The number of rows N in the first map must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns M in the first map must be between 1 and 200.
The number of columns M in the first map must be less than or equal to the number of rows N.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers i and j indicating the starting positions of the overlapping M × M sections.
